title: Training battle ground
content: I’ve been lucid dreaming since I was a child, I have been refining my lucid dreaming skills/astral projection for a while. Do any of you know of the space where u can enhance your skills. It took me until last year to be able to become invisible for what felt like 10 seconds I can land a punch now I can make fire in my palms Flying has been the hardest I can’t fly vertically like Superman in always in a sitting position But if I jump, I pass through the toposphere and other dimensions This I have no control of I hate jumping I end up fighting battles in worlds/universes/ or wtv that I’m not mentally ready for. Thoughts???
